# Poe2AutomationAccessor

[API index](../index.md)

Script-facing surface over the global Automation toggle — `World.Automation` in scripts.

Unlike [`crate::Poe2AiAccessor::Poe2AiAccessor`], this does not address an
individual HTN behavior. `SetEnabled` queues through the script host-command path so it lands
on the next game-tick boundary; the runtime dispatcher owns the actual mutation.

## IsEnabled

```typescript
IsEnabled: boolean;
```

Whether global Automation is enabled — the live user-toggle intent. This is distinct from
derived activity: it can be enabled while the game is detached or its window is backgrounded.

## SetEnabled

```typescript
SetEnabled(enabled: boolean): void;
```

Set global Automation enabled state. The runtime dispatcher queues this onto the automation
manager's control mailbox, so script code never mutates the gate mid-tick.
